root_cause.text: The SCTP transmit path for UDP-encapsulated packets (sctp_v4_xmit and sctp_v6_xmit) calls udp_tunnel_xmit_skb() and udp_tunnel6_xmit_skb() without disabling bottom halves (BH), which can cause the per-CPU recursion counters (dev_xmit_recursion_inc/dec) to become unbalanced if the context migrates between CPUs, leading to incorrect recursion limit detection and packet drops.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "udp_tunnel_xmit_skb() / udp_tunnel6_xmit_skb() are expected to run with BH disabled" and "Without local_bh_disable(), the context may move between CPUs, which can break the inc/dec pairing." The patch adds `local_bh_disable()` before and `local_bh_enable()` after those calls in both IPv4 and IPv6 paths.
